t: Saxby CosmosEco V3 Fixed LED Recessed Downlights deliver reliable, fire-rated illumination for indoor installations. These dimmable downlights feature an integrated LED source emitting a warm white 3000K colour, suitable for creating a comfortable ambience in homes, offices, and retail environments. An IP65 rating ensures suitability for bathroom zone 1, protecting against dust and water. Installation is efficient, utilising a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block and a 57mm cut-out, making them ideal for professional electricians. The robust steel body ensures lasting performance and a 50,000-hour lifespan minimises maintenance.
